name: Sunrise Sunset
note: OpenStreetMap said "Mo-Fr 08:00-00:00; Sa-Su 00:00-01:00, 08:00-00:00"; the shop's own source wins. Read: The shop's own Square site, Sunrise/Sunset 351 Evergreen Ave: business hours every day 08:00-24:00, plus SAT and SUN 00:00-01:00 (Friday and Saturday nights to 1 AM). The site's visible hours block still shows Square's 9-5 placeholder; the store's business hours are used.
